tools.name: start_website
tools.description: Prepare a new WeInc website from a description of the business. Returns a link; nothing is built or charged until the person opens it and confirms in their browser. Put everything you know into `brief`: business name, what they do, location, services, audience, tone, pages wanted, contact details. O

tools.name: find_templates
tools.description: Search WeInc's website templates by keywords (e.g. 'restaurant', 'portfolio', 'online store') and/or category. Returns id, name, description, category, features and a start link. Pass a chosen id to start_website as template_id.

tools.name: my_websites
tools.description: List the signed-in person's own WeInc websites, newest activity first: name, live URL if published, editor link and last updated time. Use the id with website_details or request_change.

tools.name: website_details
tools.description: Details of one of the person's own websites: name, whether it is published, live URL, custom domains with status, last published time and editor link.

tools.name: request_change
tools.description: Prepare a change to one of the person's own websites. Returns an editor link that opens their site with the instruction already typed in the WeInc chat box; it is NOT sent until they press send. The instruction should say what to change, where, and the exact new text.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List builder projects for the org (paginated, filterable).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project for one of the org's clients (by email).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a single project by id.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project's name, description, or status. This overwrites the current values; changing the status (for example archiving) can take the site out of normal use, so confirm with the person first.

tools.name: get_preview_urls
tools.description: Get published/preview URLs for a project.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Create a client (end-customer) for the org.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Aggregated analytics for the org (optionally one project).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_websites, get_preview_urls · Private data: start_website · Public sink: request_change, create_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_websites, get_preview_urls · Private data: start_website · Public sink: request_change, create_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "update_project" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Update a project's name, description, or status." → after: "Update a project's name, description, or status. This overwrites the current values; changing the status (for example archiving) can take the site out of normal use, so confirm with the person first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
